traditions.title: Discover the Heart of Moroccan Skincare Traditions
paragraphs: Morocco has a long and rich history of natural beauty rituals. From the argan groves of the Souss-Massa region to the mineral-rich clay of the Atlas Mountains, Moroccan skincare is built around simple but effective natural ingredients.

The Moroccan hammam is one of the best examples of this tradition. A typical hammam routine may include Moroccan black soap for cleansing, a Kessa glove for exfoliation, ghassoul clay for purifying the skin, rose water for freshness, and argan oil for final nourishment. This complete ritual has inspired beauty lovers and skincare brands worldwide.

At Moroccan Skincare, we honor this heritage by offering products that reflect authenticity, quality, and natural beauty. We focus on ingredients that carry a strong Moroccan identity and can be used in both traditional and modern cosmetic routines.

Our sourcing approach values traceability, responsible partnerships, and long-term cooperation with trusted producers and local supply networks. When you choose our Moroccan skincare products, you are choosing more than beauty ingredients — you are choosing a story of tradition, nature, and craftsmanship.

faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions for Your Business
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our wholesale orders, private label process, shipping, and export documentation.

items.q: What are your Minimum Order Quantities (MOQs) for wholesale and private label?
items.a: We maintain flexible MOQs to support growing brands as well as established distributors. For bulk oils and raw ingredients (Argan oil, Prickly Pear oil, Black Soap), orders start from just 5 liters/kilograms. For private label custom-packaged cosmetic lines with your brand logo, our minimums start at only 50 to 100 units per product.

items.q: Can we order a sample kit before placing a large commercial order?
items.a: Yes, absolutely! We strongly encourage prospective partners to test our purity and consistency. We provide customizable Sample Kits containing our core products (Argan oil, Prickly Pear seed oil, Savon Beldi, Blue Nila, Aker Fassi, and Ghassoul clay) delivered worldwide via DHL Express within 3 to 5 business days.

items.q: What quality certifications and export documentation do you provide?
items.a: Every export shipment is accompanied by comprehensive documentation: Certificate of Analysis (COA) specifying fatty acid profiles and microbiological test results, Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), Certificate of Origin (Chamber of Commerce), and Phytosanitary certificates for seamless customs clearance in the US, EU, GCC, and worldwide.

items.q: How does the Private Label (OEM/ODM) cosmetic process work?
items.a: Our turnkey private label process has 5 simple steps: 1) Select your formulas and target ingredients; 2) Choose container options (amber glass dropper bottles, jars, aluminum tubes, dispensers); 3) Send us your label artwork or let our design team create it complying with international cosmetic labeling regulations; 4) Batch production and safety testing; 5) Secure international delivery to your warehouse or fulfillment center.

items.q: How long does international shipping take and what carriers do you use?
items.a: For express air courier shipments (samples and urgent orders under 100 kg), we partner with DHL Express and FedEx with guaranteed transit times of 3 to 5 business days worldwide. items.q: What payment methods and terms do you accept for B2B orders?
items.a: We accept International Bank Wire Transfer (T/T - SWIFT), Letter of Credit (L/C) for large container orders, as well as secure credit card / PayPal payments for sample kits and small trial orders. Established wholesale accounts can qualify for flexible payment milestones.
